SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. S. B. REGISTRY 7
File No. 4297
Louza Station, 4207
Date Nov. 30th. 1932.

REPORT

Subject (in full) FURTHER REPORT ON TWO THREATENING LETTERS RECEIVED BY WAUNG SHI
VENG (汪希文) MANAGER OF THE SOCIAL NEWS AGENCY.

Made by D.S.I.Barton Forwarded by Joe H. Adams.

Sir,

With reference to Major Bourne's (D.C.Crime) instructions on
the attached memo, I beg to report that enquiries have been made
by the undersigned at No.85 Race Course Road to interview Waung
Shi Veng, when the following was learned from Hsiao Yeh Cheng
(蕭逸塵) the assistant editor.

Waung Shi Veng does not reside in Shanghai, but at Nanking
where he is a member of an Advisory Section (汪希文) of the
Nanking Government, and visits Shanghai about once a month, but
on no definite day.

Him on dept
+ Search party
Hsiao Yeh Cheng was informed that a Special Police Uniform
patrol has been detailed to patrol Race Course Road in the vicini-
ty of the house, which he stated he had noticed and was quite
satisfied with.

He was asked if he knew or had heard any information of who
the letter writers were, when he said that they were not worrying
over the letters and that before anything serious took place, they
would probably received another letter.

A.R. 2/12
D.S.I.

B.C. (Bourne)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. S. No. REGISTRY.
No. D 4207
S. 2.
Date 12 / 11 / 32
Date November 16, 1932.

Subject (in full) Two threatening letters received by Waung Shi Veng (汪希文),
Manager of the Social News Agency.
Made by Clerk Z.O. Zung. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached file on the subject
of two threatening letters received by Mr. Waung Shi Veng
(汪希文), Manager of Social News Agency (社会新闻), 85 Race
Course Road, from certain alleged Communists, I have to report
that individual enquiries made by C.D.S. 96 Dung Hai Ling
and C.D.C. 280 Li Hai Foong have failed to discover the
identity of the sender or senders of the letters in question.

The first letter, dated October 15 and signed Wong
Kuh Zien (王克全) was posted on October 15 at the sub-
station on Kung Woo Road (共和路), Chapei. Wong Kuh Zien,
according to our records, is an ex-worker of N.W.K. Cotton
Mills, and in 1926 was a member of the "Red" Section of the
local Kuomintang. He took part in the attack upon the
Headquarters of the Conservative Section of the Kuomintang
at No.44 Route Vallon on March 3, 1927. However, since the
launching of the anti-Communist campaign by the Kuomintang in
April 1927, nothing is known to this office regarding his
movements.

The second letter, dated October 25, 1932, and
signed "Hu Chien Wen (胡剑魂), Chief of Bodyguards of the
Nationalist Youth Association", was posted in the sub-station
on Rue Montauban, French Concession, on October 24. Neither
Hu Chien Wen nor the Nationalist Youth Association are known
to the staff of this office.

According to Clerk Tay Yeh of the Crime Branch
it is extremely difficult to tell whether the letters were
written by the one and same person, owing to the fact that
a foreign pen has been used for one and a Chinese pen for
the other. Whether or not the names are genuine or assumed

日期 1932年11月16日。

事由（全称）：《社会新闻》社经理汪希文（汪希文）收到两封恐吓信。
呈报人：书记员 Z.O. Zung。 转呈人：[签名]

兹就关于《社会新闻》社（社会新闻）经理汪希文先生（汪希文，地址：跑马厅路85号）收到某些所谓共产党人发出的两封恐吓信的附件档案，卑职谨此报告，经刑事侦探社警员96号董海灵（Dung Hai Ling）和刑事侦探社警员280号李海峰（Li Hai Foong）分别查询，未能查明上述信件的寄信人身份。

第一封信日期为10月15日，署名为王克全（Wong Kuh Zien），于10月15日在闸北共和路（Kung Woo Road）支局投递。根据我方记录，王克全是西北棉纺厂（N.W.K. Cotton Mills）的前工人，并于1926年成为当地国民党“左”派成员。他参与了1927年3月3日对瓦伦路（Route Vallon）44号国民党右派总部的袭击。然而，自1927年4月国民党发起反共运动以来，本局对其行踪一无所知。

第二封信日期为1932年10月25日，署名为“胡剑魂（Hu Chien Wen），国民青年团保镖队长”，于10月24日在法租界蒙陶班路（Rue Montauban）支局投递。本局职员均不知晓胡剑魂或国民青年团为何人或何组织。

据刑事科书记员戴叶（Tay Yeh）称，由于一封信使用钢笔书写，另一封信使用毛笔书写，极难判断这两封信是否出自同一人之手。至于署名是真实姓名还是化名

（左侧手写批注：）
OC (本人)
供个人
[签名]
11月19日
[签名]
11月19日

The Social News Agency, 85 Race Course Road, which
publishes a three day periodical entitled "The Social News,"
has been in existence since the beginning of October 1932.
This magazine contains nothing objectionable and it appears
to be more of an anti-Communist nature.
The names and antecedents of the manager and
editorial staff of the Social News Agency are as follows :-
Manager : Waung Shi Veng (汪希文), native of Hanyang.
During 1929 and 1930 he held the posts of
counsellor and secretary of the State Council
of the National Government.
Editor : Zung Dah Yung (程大庸), native of Hanyang.
Formerly held a similar position with several
other local newspapers at different periods.
Assistant Editors: Hsiao Yeh Cheng (蕭逸塵), native of
Ichang. During 1929 and 1930 he was a member of
the staff of the local Public Safety Bureau and
concurrently a newspaper reporter.
Assistant Editor: Dong Pah An (龐伯安), native of Soochow.
Formerly adjutant attached to the Soong Wu Garrison
Commander's Headquarters at Shanghai.
It is believed that the Social News Agency is
subsidized by the Kuomintang.
Neither Mr. Waung Shi Veng nor his staff are able
to give any information or clue that might lead to the discovery
of the source from whence the threatening letters emanated.
（批：30 / 7/6）
Ging Goong Qin
Clerk.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

位于跑马厅路85号的《社会新闻》社出版一份名为《社会新闻》的三日刊，该社自1932年10月初成立至今。该杂志内容并无不当之处，且似乎更具反共性质。
《社会新闻》社经理及编辑人员的姓名和背景如下：
经理：汪希文（Waung Shi Veng），汉阳人。
1929年和1930年间，他曾担任国民政府国务会议顾问及秘书。
编辑：程大庸（Zung Dah Yung），汉阳人。
此前曾在不同时期担任本地其他几家报纸的类似职务。
助理编辑：萧逸尘（Hsiao Yeh Cheng），宜昌人。
1929年和1930年间，他是本地公安局职员，同时兼任报社记者。
助理编辑：庞伯安（Dong Pah An），苏州人。
此前曾任驻上海宋武（音译）卫戍司令部副官。
据信，《社会新闻》社由国民党提供资助。
汪希文先生及其职员均无法提供任何可能导致查明恐吓信来源的信息或线索。
（批：30 / 7/6）
Ging Goong Qin
书记员。

page_data.en:
To the Editor,
Social News Agency.

Sir,

I read at a friend's place in the 3rd issue of the
Social News an article entitled "The New Tendency of the
Internal Trouble of the Communist Party". It is entirely
different from true facts and needs correction, so will you
please have my letter published on the front page of the
paper.

Though there is some divergence of opinion regarding
the political policy of the Party, there is not the so-
called Right Wing nor does there exist any dispute. The
spread of the present national revolution does not allow me
to rest and enjoy leisure but needs me to stand at the fore-
front of the revolution in the struggle for ultimate success.
This Mr. Zui Sung does not understand nor is he willing to
understand and there leaves no doubt that he wrote the mean,
nonsensical and self-cheating article in his small room.

I am not acquainted with your paper. It is totally
universe for your paper to publish a mean article which is
calculated to hinder people's freedom of action. It is
hoped that this letter be published and groundless news be
no more inserted in future. Otherwise, don't blame us for
lack of sympathy and cruel measures. This serves as our
warning to you.

Wang Kuh Zien
15.10.38.
page_data.zh:
致《社会新闻》社编辑：

先生：

我在朋友处读到《社会新闻》第三期上刊登的一篇题为《共产党内部纠纷的新趋向》的文章。该文与事实完全不符，需要更正，因此请贵报将此信刊登在报纸头版。

虽然党内对政治政策存在一些意见分歧，但并不存在所谓的右翼，也不存在任何争端。当前国民革命的蓬勃发展使我不容休息和享受闲暇，而需要我站在革命斗争的最前列以争取最终胜利。这一点崔松（Zui Sung，音译）先生并不理解，也不愿理解，这无疑表明他那篇卑鄙、荒谬且自欺欺人的文章是在其斗室中写就的。

我与贵报素不相识。贵报刊登旨在阻碍人们行动自由的卑鄙文章，是完全不合理的（原文 universe 疑为 unwise 或 unjustified 之误，此处照实译为不合理/不妥）。希望此信得以刊登，且今后不再插入毫无根据的新闻。否则，勿怪我们缺乏同情并采取严厉措施。特此警告。

王克全
1938年10月15日。
